worked_solution:
Using the properties of addition/subtraction and scalar multiplication of vectors to isolate the $h$ term, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}3{a}_{1}+h{a}_{2} & =b \\ 3[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -1 \\ 2 \\ 1\end{aligned}]+h[\begin{aligned}-3 \\ 2 \\ 4 \\ 1\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}-3 \\ 1 \\ 14 \\ 5\end{aligned}] \\ h[\begin{aligned}-3 \\ 2 \\ 4 \\ 1\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}-3 \\ 1 \\ 14 \\ 5\end{aligned}]-3[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -1 \\ 2 \\ 1\end{aligned}] \\ h[\begin{aligned}-3 \\ 2 \\ 4 \\ 1\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}-6 \\ 4 \\ 8 \\ 2\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

From the final equation above, we can tell that $h=2.$
